name: Covariance Analysis
description: Combines a direct covariance ($OCM), the scatter of an element-set series ($OMM) and sensor biases, given as one $SBC covariance request, into one object's RTN covariance: a $OCM with the combined 6x6 lower triangle, and a $SBC with the diagnostics (contributors, the variance each added, one-sigma values, position covariance, ellipsoid semi-axes).

sequentialJustification.detail: Each invocation combines one object's covariance, TLE sample scatter and sensor biases into one fixed-size 6x6 covariance product. The kernel performs ordered scalar reductions and sorts three diagonal position sigmas without spawning guest threads; independent objects are parallelized by the caller.

inputPorts.description: One $SBC with its REQUEST arm: OBJECT_ID, EPOCH, DIRECT_COVARIANCE ($OCM, 21-value lower triangle; per-axis sigmas as a diagonal), ELEMENT_SET_SERIES ($OMM) and SENSOR_BIASES (RADIAL_M, IN_TRACK_M, CROSS_TRACK_M).

outputPorts.description: The combined covariance as an $OCM: COVARIANCE_DATA (21 values, LTM, km**2 family) at the request EPOCH, COV_REF_FRAME the direct covariance's frame (RTN by name when none).
The $SBC DIAGNOSTICS arm of the combination.
